findings.title: Associate scope and policies must stay distinct
findings.evidence: CLA has 23 numbered objectives in four blocks; entry-level TestNow rules differ from Pearson associate rules.
findings.recommendation: Map all objectives and distinguish C17 practice from unspecified exam language mode; retain appointment-policy conflict explicitly.
findings.resolution: Map all objectives and distinguish C17 practice from unspecified exam language mode; retain appointment-policy conflict explicitly.

findings.title: Allocation operand is used before declaration
findings.evidence: The existing fragment computes sizeof *items before items is declared; complete diagnostic driver rejects it.
findings.recommendation: Supply a real size helper and declared type, checked multiplication, positive-size growth and executable failure paths.
findings.resolution: Supply a real size helper and declared type, checked multiplication, positive-size growth and executable failure paths.

findings.title: A positive delta can still overflow signed int
findings.evidence: The prior update function accepted any positive delta without proving representability.
findings.recommendation: Check INT_MAX minus delta before addition and test null, nonpositive, exact-boundary and signed-minimum cases.
findings.resolution: Check INT_MAX minus delta before addition and test null, nonpositive, exact-boundary and signed-minimum cases.

findings.title: Growth needs transactional ownership and lifetime rules
findings.evidence: Realloc zero-size behavior and old aliases cannot be treated as ordinary positive allocation failure.
findings.recommendation: Use a temporary pointer with positive requested sizes, update capacity only after success, and preserve caller data on failed loads.
findings.resolution: Use a temporary pointer with positive requested sizes, update capacity only after success, and preserve caller data on failed loads.

findings.title: Formatted assignment count does not validate a record
findings.evidence: Numeric conversion can overflow and a matching failure is not EOF; the old loop conflates parse and termination behavior.
findings.recommendation: Implement bounded lines and complete strtol/strtod conversion with range/domain/NUL/length checks and separate status values.
findings.resolution: Implement bounded lines and complete strtol/strtod conversion with range/domain/NUL/length checks and separate status values.

findings.title: Parentheses do not establish evaluation sequencing
findings.evidence: The square macro repeats its argument; conflicting increments remain undefined despite grouping.
findings.recommendation: Execute side-effect-free macro comparisons and a bounded typed-function alternative, with configuration/preprocessor checks.
findings.resolution: Execute side-effect-free macro comparisons and a bounded typed-function alternative, with configuration/preprocessor checks.

findings.title: File ownership includes final close results
findings.evidence: Placeholder read-error comments and unchecked fclose do not implement cleanup/error reporting.
findings.recommendation: Provide owned-path and borrowed-stream APIs with checked close and output flush; record uninduced low-level failure paths.
findings.resolution: Provide owned-path and borrowed-stream APIs with checked close and output flush; record uninduced low-level failure paths.

findings.title: Appointment wording and inaccessible interiors remain unresolved
findings.evidence: Anytime-before and 24-hour rescheduling statements conflict; actual booking and paid lessons not inspected.
findings.recommendation: Keep the support limitation visible pending authoritative evidence.
